title: erinus viscosus
intro: Erinus viscosus, commonly known as sticky mouse-ear or sticky cranesbill, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). Erinus viscosus has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which help soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Erinus viscosus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
